scenarios.title: Dethrone triggers when the creature attacks the player with the most life

setup.notes: Enraged Revolutionary is a 2/1 with dethrone.

decisions: A declares Enraged Revolutionary as an attacker against B.
Both players pass; the dethrone trigger, if it fired, resolves.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B (20 life) has more life than A (15), so dethrone fires: Enraged Revolutionary gets a +1/+1 counter, deals 3 damage and B is at 17.

variants.label: tied
variants.delta: B's life total is 15, tied with A's.
variants.expected: B is tied for the most life, so dethrone fires: a +1/+1 counter, 3 damage, B is at 12.

variants.label: less-life
variants.delta: B's life total is 14, less than A's 15.
variants.expected: Dethrone does not fire. Enraged Revolutionary stays 2/1 with no counter, deals 2 damage and B is at 12.

scenarios.title: Each instance of dethrone triggers separately

setup.notes: Enraged Revolutionary (2/1) has dethrone itself; Marchesa, the Black Rose (3/3) gives other creatures A controls dethrone, so Enraged Revolutionary has two instances. Marchesa does not attack.

decisions: A declares only Enraged Revolutionary as an attacker against B.
Both players pass; the dethrone triggers resolve.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Two dethrone triggers fire and resolve: Enraged Revolutionary gets two +1/+1 counters (4/3), deals 4 damage and B is at 16.

variants.label: single-instance
variants.delta: Marchesa, the Black Rose is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: One dethrone trigger fires: one +1/+1 counter (3/2), 3 damage and B is at 17.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may collapse a granted keyword that duplicates the card's own into one instance.
